'''PVP Seasons''' ---- '''PVP Seasons''' are a feature where players are rewarded for winning [[PVP]] matches. By reaching high enough ELO values, '''PVP Seasons''' will give the player various cosmetics like skins, stickers or emotes. ELO gained is based on the rank of the opponents. {| class="empty-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" |[[File:PVPReleaseThumbnail.png|300px|link=PVP Season 0]] |- |[[PVP Season 0]] |- |23 July 2025 – 22 October 2025 |}
